observed: Loop this clip visibly shortened green loop range to one bar (2.1 seconds). Playback failed again within roughly ten seconds. Naming and Save as succeeded, with project title Neon steps and no unsaved dot. File menu also clearly exposes Export WAV. Actual sound still unverified.

actions: Context menu Duplicate; Duplicate tool twice; Select; drag loop-range right edge toward bar 5; Ctrl+S; File > Export WAV; inspect Type; keep WAV; Export; OK
expectation: Repeat the phrase across the drum rhythm and export the whole song.
observed: Duplicate places each copy immediately after the current one. Tool hint Click a clip to duplicate is clear. Four phrases now match the drum length. Dragging loop end a long distance only lengthened range to 2.1.3 (2.4 seconds), not bar 5; uncertain whether application or simulated input. Ctrl+S did not visibly clear dirty dot. Export defaults to whole Arrangement, shows 8.571 seconds, and completed with success banner. Types include MP3 though menu is Export WAV.
audio_evidence: Coordinator reports actual nonzero audio in 12-second capture near 16:38:12; no subjective listening assessment by participant.

actions: Range > Loop playback over arrangement; File > Save; fourth phrase > Edit notes > Clip > Octave up; Back; File > Save; Re-export last WAV (replace)
expectation: Make the whole piece repeat and make the last repetition higher for variation.
observed: Range menu makes whole-arrangement looping easy after drag trouble. Menu Save clears dirty dot. Octave up visibly changes fourth phrase C4/G4/F4/D4 labels to C5/G5/F5/D5. Re-export succeeded quickly without repeating settings.

actions: File > Export WAV > Type MP3 > Export > OK; File > Open > Neon steps.rill; fourth phrase > Edit notes; Back
expectation: Have a familiar shareable file and be able to return to the saved song.
observed: MP3 export success banner shown. Open picker showed Neon steps.rill (3.3 MB). Reopened project retained all four phrases, whole-arrangement loop range, and high final phrase (C5/G5/F5/D5 labels). Final view returned to Arranger.
environment_update: Coordinator established earlier Ctrl+S no-op was missing Xvfb window focus after native picker; not an established RILL defect. Driver later restored clicked-window focus.
